question: Polycystic ovarian morphology (PCOM) on ultrasound is defined as ≥20 follicles (2–9 mm) per ovary OR an ovarian volume >10 mL on either ovary (using modern high-frequency transducers).

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is actually true. The 2018 ESHRE/ASRM guidelines updated the PCOM threshold to ≥20 follicles per ovary OR ovarian volume >10 mL. The older threshold of ≥12 follicles applied to lower-resolution equipment.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. The 2018 revised threshold raised the follicle count from ≥12 to ≥20 per ovary, reflecting improved ultrasound resolution with modern transducers. Ovarian volume >10 mL on either ovary is an alternative PCOM criterion.
